answers.answer: Met. Our ISO/IEC 27001 certification covers development, hosting and operation of all Nordlys Accounts & Data services. The certificate is valid until September 2028.

Partly met. We can provide references to a Swedish savings bank live since 2023 and a Danish regional bank live since 2025; both are Accounts & Data reference customers and have agreed to act as references. The available information does not specify the exact solution scope delivered at each bank, so we cannot confirm comparability from it alone. We offer these two customers as references, subject to confirmation of the delivered scope.
answers.note: Sales to confirm the solution scope delivered to each reference customer and whether it meets the comparability requirement.

The commercial/finance specialist must provide a credit rating or the available audited financial statements and confirm whether they demonstrate sufficient financial capacity for a contract of this size.

answers.answer: Met. We provide a standard information package for the bank's DORA register of information. It includes all subcontractors that support critical functions.
Met. We support retail and business deposit accounts, including current accounts, savings accounts and fixed-term deposits.
Met. Our interest and fee engine uses configurable rules, including tiered and date-dependent rates.
Met. The bank's product team can set up new account products in a configuration tool without code changes. At reference customers, launch typically takes 4–6 weeks from decision.
Met. We support joint accounts and multiple authorised users, with individual rights for each user.
Met. We support sub-accounts, or savings pots, linked to a main account.
Met. We support account opening, changes and closure, with a complete audit history.
Met. We support blocking accounts and specific amounts, with reason codes.

Partly met. Balances and transactions are updated in under one second after booking. The available evidence does not confirm that the mobile app, online bank and adviser tools all show the same information within two seconds.
Met. Our parallel-run toolkit supports daily automatic reconciliation of balances between the legacy core system and Nordlys.
Met. We publish account events to an event streaming platform that other systems can subscribe to.
Met. Nordlys scales horizontally and has been load-tested at five times normal peak volume. This provides capacity for peak loads such as salary days and the days before Christmas.
Met. All services are available through REST APIs, with OpenAPI 3 specifications.
Met. Nordlys provides PSD2 account-information and payment-initiation APIs following the Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 standard. The APIs include consent management.

Partly met. Nordlys has a PSD3/PSR readiness programme on its roadmap and plans to deliver changes in standard releases once the final rules apply. The capability sheet does not describe preparation activities or milestones before the rules are final.
Met. Nordlys provides a developer portal with a partner sandbox and test data.
Met. Nordlys logs the time, caller and consent reference for API calls. Log retention is configurable up to 10 years, allowing retention for at least five years.

Partly met. Nordlys offers a connector framework for SME accounting platforms and ready-made connectors for selected Nordic platforms. The capability sheet does not confirm coverage of your specific accounting platform or platforms.
Met. Nordlys provides the bank with a documented common data model covering customers, accounts, products and transactions.
Met. Nordlys provides a data product catalogue in which each data product has an owner, definition and quality rules.
Met. Nordlys provides data quality dashboards measuring completeness, accuracy and timeliness.
Partly met. Nordlys provides lineage from source systems into the data platform. Lineage from the data platform into the bank’s own reporting tools is not included.
Met. Nordlys allows the bank to export all its data at any time and at contract end in open formats, including Parquet and CSV, with documentation.

Partly met. We provide a governed SQL workspace for analysts. Python notebooks are planned for 2027; the current capability sheet does not confirm that analysts can use Python or prevent copying data to unmanaged spreadsheets.

Met. We provide standard data feeds for Norwegian regulatory reports through a reporting partner, with documented calculation rules. The capability sheet does not name the individual reporting authorities.
Met. Reporting data is automatically reconciled against the general ledger, and differences generate alerts.
Met. Nordlys monitors regulatory changes and updates standard reports in quarterly releases. Nordlys is responsible for those updates.

Met. Our data quality assistant is in production and finds anomalies and suggests corrections, which a person must approve. An adviser insight summary is in pilot, with general availability planned for 2027; it summarises customer account activity.

Met. For each AI function, our documentation package describes its purpose, data used, explanation method and human review points. The data quality assistant requires a person to approve corrections, while the adviser summary shows the data on which each summary is based.
Met. The data quality assistant's suggested corrections require approval by a person. The adviser insight summary makes no automated decisions.
Met. We do not use customer data to train models outside the customer's own environment without the customer's written consent.

Partly met. For each AI function, we provide documentation that includes its risk classification under the EU AI Act. The capability sheet does not describe broader support for the bank's EU AI Act obligations.

Partly met. Hosting and backups are in Norway and Finland. Under the standard support model, third-line technical support includes an engineering team outside the EU/EEA; access can be restricted to EU/EEA staff as a paid option.
Met. We encrypt data in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256.
Met. We provide role-based access control and multi-factor authentication for all users, including administrative users.
Met. We notify customers of serious incidents within two hours of detection, which is within the required four-hour limit.
Met. We participate in customer resilience testing, including threat-led penetration testing (TLPT).

Partly met. We provide a standard exit plan and exit assistance described in the service agreement, and can export all data in open formats with documentation. The available information does not confirm that the plan specifically enables transfer to another supplier or back in-house.
Met. We issue an ISAE 3402 Type 2 report annually.
Partly met. Our premium SLA provides 99.95% monthly availability for an extra cost. The standard SLA is 99.9%.
Partly met. Planned maintenance is announced 14 days in advance, and our standard maintenance window is 00:00–04:00. This starts one hour earlier than the requested 01:00–05:00 window.
Partly met. We provide 24/7 support in English for critical incidents. Norwegian-speaking support is available on weekdays from 08:00 to 16:00, not 24/7.
Met. Our recovery targets are an RTO of two hours and an RPO of one minute, within the requested limits.
Met. We provide a monthly service report covering availability, incidents, capacity and service requests.

Partly met. Our phased approach typically starts with the data platform and read-only APIs, then moves to real-time account services and migration of products and history. This approach is described as low risk with early value, but the available information does not confirm that every phase is independently usable.

Partly met. Our typical plan starts with the data platform and read-only APIs, described as low risk and delivering early value. The available information does not establish that this is the area of highest value or explain a comparative rationale for choosing it first.
Met. Our migration toolkit includes test migrations, automatic reconciliation and rollback for each migration step.
Met. The bank should plan for 6–10 FTE in each phase. This typically includes a product owner, architects, testers and data owners.
